meta.title: Gopalan AI · Cattle scoring & breed
meta.description: Check your cattle or buffalo's body condition and breed from a photo, plan feeding and get reminders.

home.heroTitle: Check your animal's health from a photo
home.heroText: Body condition, breed and a feeding plan in about a minute.
home.signInText: Sign in to save results, track body condition over time and get reminders.
home.eyebrow: For farmers and the Rashtriya Gokul Mission
home.heroTitleDesktop: Know your animal's health from one photo
home.heroLead: Gopalan AI measures your cow or buffalo, scores its body condition and recognises the breed. Then it helps you plan feeding and reminds you what's due.
home.step1Text: Stand beside the animal with the printed 20 cm marker next to it.
home.step2Text: The AI places the body points. Drag any orange point that's off.
home.step3Text: Body condition score, breed, measurements and what to do next.
home.f1Text: A consistent 1–5 score in 0.25 steps, explained in plain words.
home.f2Text: 16 Indian cattle and buffalo breeds, or an honest "not sure".
home.f3Text: The lowest-cost mix of the feeds you have that meets your animal's needs.
home.f4Text: Feeding, vaccination, deworming, breeding dates and check-ups.
home.bannerTitle: Keep every animal's history in one place
home.bannerText: Sign in to save results, watch body condition change over time and get reminders on your phone.
home.examplePoints: 8 body points placed by the AI
home.exampleAlt: A Red Sindhi cow with the body points placed by the AI
